checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same golden retriever recognisable in same pose
must.why: Front-facing seated dog, tongue out, tail to the right, same park setting.
Eyes, nose, tongue and ears are crisp versus the very blurry source.

must.item: Natural fur/edges, no halos or invented detail
must.why: Looks fairly natural, though slightly over-crisp and HDR-like; the grass has a few invented twigs and blades.
Trees, cars, hedge and grass match the layout, with minor redrawn details.

must.item: 640 px long edge, source aspect ratio kept
must.why: The image I viewed appears about 512 px, but the viewer may have rescaled it. The square ratio matches the source.

faults.what: Fine details such as grass and fur were redrawn, so they differ from the source. The look is slightly over-processed.
The delivered size may be 512 px instead of the requested 640 px, which I could not confirm.

summary: The output is a clear, natural-looking version of the same dog and scene. The only doubt is whether the delivered size is exactly 640 px.
